questions.q: What fell into Tobit's eyes as he slept by the wall, and blinded him?
questions.evidence: and, mine eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into mine eyes, and white films came in mine eyes

questions.q: How many husbands had Sarah lost before Tobias came?
questions.evidence: because that she had been given to seven husbands, and Asmodaeus the evil spirit killed them, before they had lain with her
And he went to seek a man, and found Raphael which was an angel

questions.q: What leaped out of the river at Tobias as he washed?
questions.evidence: But the young man went down to wash himself, and a fish leaped out of the river, and would have swallowed up the young man

questions.q: When the demon smelled the smoke, where did it flee?
questions.evidence: But when the devil smelled the smell, he fled into the uppermost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him

questions.q: What did Tobias put on his father's eyes to heal them?
questions.evidence: and took hold of his father: and he struck the gall on his father’s eyes, saying, Be of good cheer, my father

questions.q: Raphael said he was one of how many holy angels?
questions.evidence: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and go in before the glory of the Holy One
